notes: Rejected on trademark grounds, not quality. The full-size top view shows a clearly embossed circular brand emblem on the closed leather cover, and the same mark repeats on the open cover flap. CC0 waives copyright but explicitly does not waive trademark rights, so redistributing this as-is would carry a mark we cannot clear. Model quality is otherwise excellent.
limitations: Embossed manufacturer emblem on the cover; CC0 does not grant trademark rights.
Supplied as open and closed variants in one scene.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
